sourceRules: No paid provider, geocoding queries, fabricated prices, replicated locations, real reservations or production writes. The tested public distance capability depends on the address-bound point, not on membership or current calendar availability. The local report excludes separately hosted partner rows unless deduplicated against a verified snapshot.
